findings.description: The ledger URL was verified independently of the DATABASE_URL used for business writes, so the admitted database/login could differ from the writer target. Enforced mode now requires both URLs to match the reviewed direct host, port, database and login with only sslmode=verify-full.
findings.regression: The new regression failed before the fix because a missing or mismatched application URL still created the admission connection. All 11 focused admission tests pass after the fix, including no-connection/no-effect rejection and sanitized errors.
